beats.text: Would you have survived to five in eighteen hundred? The whole world, since then.
In eighteen hundred: forty-three out of a hundred. Each dot is one child.
Even in nineteen hundred, more than one in three.
Then came vaccines, clean water and antibiotics.
Today: about four out of a hundred.
That's the real reason life expectancy doubled.

sources: Share of children dying before age 5, world, 1800–2017: Gapminder (gd005, until 1950s) and World Bank (2019), compiled by Our World in Data (owid-datasets 'Global child mortality (since 1800) - based on Gapminder and World Bank (2019)'). 1800: 43.3 %, 1900: 36.2 %, 1975: 12.9 %, 2017: 3.9 %.

UN IGME 2023/24 estimates for recent years are similar (about 3.7 % in 2023). Historical values before 1950 are estimates with large uncertainty. Life expectancy link: see No. 154 (England 41 in 1870 -> 81 today), driven mainly by falling child mortality.
